h8gxqtfs.sourceDescription: Snowflecked Pop Up Tree - Pre-Lit, Pre-Decorated & Effortlessly ElegantCreate instant festive magic with the Snowflecked Pop Up Tree - a beautifully simple solution for effortless Christmas decorating. Pre-lit with warm white LED lights and adorned with elegant gold baubles, this tree arrives ready to shine. Its snow-flecked PVC foliage offers a classic wintry look, enhanced by a soft frosted finish that adds charm and depth without the mess of real snow. Best of all, there's no branch fluffing required. Just take it out of the box, assemble the stand, insert the central pole, and suspend the tree into place - it's that easy. Then simply plug it in and enjoy the glow. Perfect for those who want a stylish tree with zero hassle, the Snowflecked Pop Up Tree is ideal for homes, offices, and festive events where speed, convenience, and style all matter. vy9w227p.sourceDescription: Let it snow this festive season with this sensational Snowy Alpine wreath from Christmas Tree World! This beautiful 45cm Christmas wreath is fantastic for setting the Yuletide tone for any home. With its large flocked branch tips, natural green foliage, and pre-attached mini pine cones and red berries, this artificial wreath always looks the part every December! Please note: Snowy Alpine garland is not included with wreath. Boasting the same high-quality PE/PVC branch tips as our Snowy Alpine tree, customers love the realistic and elegant look of this pre-decorated Snowy Alpine wreath. Best of all, this pre-lit Christmas wreath comes with pre-attached LEDs so all you need to do is pop up and enjoy the magic – no stringing lights required! Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

Product details: • Brand: Homescapes. • Dimensions: 175 x 25 x 25 cm. • Colour: White and red. • Material: Plastic and metal.
